tool_signatures.name: put_api_v1_catalog_name
tool_signatures.description: Relabels every tap and pipeline whose `catalog` equals `name` to `newName`, each through a versioned write (one new definition version per member, with a change note naming the rename and the actor). Every hidden placeholder of the catalog (a `__catalog__*` tap whose `catalog` field is `name`, or whose name suffix is `name` when that field is empty) is removed, and `__catalog__<newName>` is created with `catalog=newName`. A member already moved out of `name` by a concurrent change is listed under `failed` ("no longer in catalog"), and placeholders are left untouched when no member moved. A rename never merges: if `newName` already exists (any tap or pipeline carries it, or it has a placeholder; matched case-sensitively) the request is refused with 409 and nothing changes. To combine catalogs, move their items. Not transactional: members that fail are listed under `failed` and the rest still move (207). API keys whose capabilities are scoped `catalog=<name>` are listed under `affectedKeys`; their scopes are not rewritten. Catalog operations (rename, detach, cascade) are serialized server-side, so concurrent requests run one after another and the later one sees the earlier one's result. Requires `pipeline:update`; each member is also checked against the key's owner and catalog scopes. If any member is refused by scope, placeholders are left untouched (`placeholder: skipped`); for a catalog with only a placeholder, the placeholder is scope-checked (403 on denial). Refused with 409 while an ordered enable of the catalog (`POST /api/v1/catalog/{name}/enable-ordered`) is running.
